title: Unit – 5 : Session – 3 : SLO – 1  |  Implementing Automata with the Python automata Library
sections: 1. Library — the automata-lib library (pip install automata-lib), specifically automata.fa.dfa.DFA and automata.fa.nfa.NFA, is used to define DFAs/NFAs in Python.
2. Acceptance check — dfa.accepts_input("0101") returns True/False; dfa.read_input("0101") returns the final state.
3. Defining a transition — transitions are given as a nested dictionary: transitions={"q0": {"0": "q1", "1": "q0"}, "q1": {"0": "q1", "1": "q0"}} — i.e. δ(state, symbol) = next state.
